findings.criterion: The page renders with a warm parchment background (#FDFBF7), charcoal ink text (#1C1A17), and brass accents (#C5A059).
findings.evidence: The styles.css file defines CSS variables matching these exact hex codes: --bg-parchment: #FDFBF7, --text-charcoal: #1C1A17, and --accent-brass: #C5A059, which are applied to the body background, text color, and borders/accents respectively.

findings.criterion: Users can add and remove decision options via a clean, accessible form.
findings.evidence: The index.html contains the form '#add-option-form' with input '#option-name' and button '#add-option-btn'. The app.js file handles the submit event, adds options to the state, and renders a 'Remove' button with window.removeOption to delete options.

findings.criterion: Users can add and remove customizable criteria.
findings.evidence: The index.html contains the form '#add-criterion-form' with input '#criterion-name' and button '#add-criterion-btn'. The app.js file handles the submit event, adds criteria to the state, and renders a 'Remove' button with window.removeCriterion to delete criteria.

findings.criterion: The layout is responsive and adapts seamlessly from mobile screens to wide desktop monitors.
findings.evidence: The styles.css file implements a responsive grid layout using '.atelier-grid' with a media query '@media (max-width: 900px)' that switches the layout from a 320px sidebar grid to a single-column layout.

findings.criterion: No external CDNs, packages, or web fonts are loaded.
findings.evidence: The index.html file only links to the local 'styles.css' and 'app.js' files, and uses system serif/sans-serif fonts and inline SVGs instead of external assets.
